data.body: AC evidence (Gerrit 1885 PS3, commit c189b8b99d, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, CI run 32207604822 success; 27/27 facade tests and 3247 reconciler/interfaces tests green). AC1 imports/construction/loader/signatures unchanged -> test_public_call_signatures_unchanged pins parameter names+kinds for 32 public methods and guards against drift hidden behind **kwargs; TestLoadBindingStore and the whole pre-existing suite cover the import/constructor path. AC2 pending/confirmed/reverse + shallow all_bindings -> test_pending_confirmed_and_reverse_survive_a_reload (real round trip through the repository-owned files) and test_all_bindings_stays_a_shallow_outer_copy (fresh outer mapping, live inner entries). AC3 same bytes and exception surface as the direct repository contract -> test_facade_writes_byte_identical_state_to_the_repository and test_facade_and_repository_agree_on_the_corruption_disposition, plus test_top_level_insert_on_a_legacy_store_reaches_the_persisted_bytes. AC4 peer-state and GET-rotation remain independent owners -> test_peer_state_and_rotation_remain_independent_owners (collaborator invocation as membership plus observable effects: baseline round-trips, rotation stamp reaches the sidecar). AC5 no caller receives writable repository access -> test_no_public_attribute_exposes_a_writable_repository scans every public attribute and zero-arg method. binding_store.py 799 -> 710 LOC. Six defect-seeded mutations all RED. Two LLM-Review advisories applied (removed change-detector coupling: rendered-annotation assertions and an exact ordered call trace). docs/env-vars.md regenerated for the shifted _env_int line reference.
